# #28 Human view vs agent view — blind QA report

**Verdict: FAIL (1 major, AC-28.18 dark theme). Everything else passes.**
Scripts: `.verify/qa/28/{api,ui,contrast,dark}.mjs`. Each ran on a throwaway stack (`scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- …`), prod build, real Chromium.
Results: api.mjs 49/50 (the 1 FAIL was a bad test input, `fields=markdown` is not a valid field). ui.mjs 46/47 (the 1 FAIL is D1). JSON in `.verify/qa/28/*-results.json`.
I did not read the implementation diff or the src/ and server/ code.

## Edge cases (all PASS unless noted)
- **Strip edge cases.** CRLF. Uppercase/no-space `<!--AGENT-->`. 3-space indent (marker) and 4-space indent (literal). Marker in a list item, both continuation and after a blank line (literal). Blockquote (literal). Inline `foo <!-- agent -->` (literal). Markers inside ``` and ~~~ fences (literal). Front matter (literal). Adjacent sections (count 2). Whole-doc section (empty output, page shows only the notice: `whole-doc-human.png`). Nested opener ignored. Notes markers kept. Flexible whitespace and trailing tab. A fence opened inside a section.
- **Labels.** A `<script>`/`onerror` label is shown as literal text and nothing executes. A 100-char label is cut to 80 + `…`.
- **Singular wording.** "1 agent-only section hidden" and "showing 1 agent-only section".
- **Review mode.** A comment anchored inside a hidden section: clicking it in the sidebar switches to `?view=agent` (replaceState) and scrolls to the line (`review-after-click.png`).
- **View params.** `?view=agent&embed=1` shows the human view with no banner and leaves the URL alone. `?view=AGENT` and `?view=bogus` → read with `view=read`.
- **Raw URLs.** All-hex slug `.md` → 200. `.MD` → 404 (the SPA fallback serves it as text/html, acceptable).
- **Live poll.** A PUT that adds a section changes the notice from 1 to 2 while in human view. The new section stays hidden.
- **Back/forward.** Show + Reader view add no history entries, so Back goes to `/library` and Forward returns to the human view.
- **Keyboard.** Tab reaches Show (2px solid focus outline, `kbd-show-focus.png`); Enter switches to agent view. Tab reaches Reader view; Space switches back.
- **Viewports.** No horizontal scroll at 390 or 820. Notice and banner fit, and the buttons are at least 27px tall (`phone-*.png`, `tablet-*.png`). On the phone the banner buttons wrap onto a second row, which is fine.
- **TOC.** Hidden headings are excluded in human view; that view has 1 entry, so no TOC per #3 rule 9. Agent view TOC lists "Evidence Heading".
- **Print.** Human view print text has no agent content and the notice is hidden. Agent-view print shows the sections and hides the banner.

## Defects
- **D1 — major (fails AC-28.18 in 1 of 6 themes).** In the `dark` theme the notice's `Show` button text, rgb(224,90,66) on rgb(36,36,40), has a contrast of **4.21:1**. It is 15px/600, which is not large text, so AA needs 4.5:1.
  - Repro: set `localStorage['md-review-theme']='dark'`, open a doc with sections, measure `[data-testid=agent-sections-show]`.
  - The notice span itself is 6.78:1, so a reading of the AC that only checks the span would pass. The button is the notice's actionable text, though.
  - Screenshots: `.verify/qa/28/dark-notice-dark.png`, `theme-dark-notice.png`.
  - Fix: use a lighter accent tint or the body-text colour for the button in dark mode. The banner buttons are fine: 7.61:1 in dark.
- **N1 — cosmetic/info.** `GET /paste/:id?fields=meta&view=human` adds `view`/`agentSections` even when `markdown` was not requested. Harmless and not covered by the spec.
